test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Foul play

options.text: A bad smelling theatre or playground
A drama which is badly produced

solution:
The correct answer is **'Unfair or dishonest behaviour'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Foul play' **is **'Unfair or dishonest behaviour'.**
 
• **Foul play:** a criminal act that results in serious damage or injury, especially murder. (एक आपराधिक कृत्य जिसके परिणामस्वरूप गंभीर क्षति या चोट लगती है, विशेष रूप से हत्या)
 
 
• *Example: It is not clear what caused the explosion, but the police do not suspect** foul play.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Unfair or dishonest behaviour.*
